title: First run: sign in through the window, the agent connects to the server

steps.step: Client 01 - First run: the sign-in page
steps.expected: Sign in, the server, user name and password
steps.actual: English | Sign in to ITSguard Server Online | Sign in with the user name and password you received, or open a new account. | Backup server | https://localhost:8443 | Use a different server address | I already have an account | I am a new customer — open an account | User name | Password | Code from the authenticator app (only if it is on) | Sign in | Need help? Contact support.
the field 'User name' has no name in UI Automation (a screen reader says only 'edit'); the robot found it under its label
the field 'Password' has no name in UI Automation (a screen reader says only 'edit'); the robot found it under its label
ITSguard Server Online: This computer is connected. Now choose what to back up.

steps.actual: New backup | Files are encrypted on this computer before they leave, with your password.
